hints.title: Sliding Window of Length Three
hints.text: Inspect every 3-character window starting at index i from 0 to n - 3.

hints.title: Pairwise Inequality Check
hints.text: A 3-character window s[i..i+2] has distinct characters if all three characters differ from each other.

hints.title: Accumulate Valid Windows
hints.text: Increment the answer counter whenever the condition holds.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: n is length of string s
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Full set construction per window adds minor overhead when direct pairwise comparison is immediate.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant time character comparisons check all length 3 windows in O(n) total time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate performs direct inequality comparison without unnecessary data structures.
